pages.text: About the world, now and then: a $(l)zerg nest$() under the ground with its brood; a $(l)xel'naga temple$() deep below, a spiral stair down from a little shrine; $(l)Dehaka's cave$(); an abandoned $(l)terran outpost$(). Wild packs wait in their hearts until a player comes: zerg packs, protoss by a lone pylon, dark templars in caves.

$(l)Terran camps$() are rare and of four kinds — a campfire, a sandbag post with a watchtower, a crashed supply pod, a field tent — with one or two soldiers mostly. $(l)Changelings$() lurk in caves: seeing you they take your look and follow you.
